d:
Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty triumphed in the final of the French Open Super750 with a straight-game 21-13, 21-19 demolition of Chinese Taipei's Lu Ching Yao and Yang Po Han in the men's doubles category. This win is India’s 1st Men's Doubles title at the French Open in 39 years.
Revisit this momentous final game and share your favourite bits with us.
